correctness.rationale: Every shattered static set uses at most one query per position; for q=3 a four-consecutive-position obstruction follows from the triple 101 witness condition, while 3-position alternation blocks separated by a free vertex shatter the matching maximum. For q>=4 alternating colour pairs on selected and unselected vertices realize all n patterns. Ldim<=n for all palette sizes since every positive query fixes one coordinate; for q>=3 a sequential adaptive binary-choice strategy attains n, while q=2 has only two hypotheses. Exact finite check uses provided standalone program (q3 n<=7 etc). No unproved lemma or numeric extrapolation is required.

value.rationale: The exact palette phase transition produces an unbounded gap on single connected paths of maximum degree two at q=3, but no gap at q=2 or q>=4. Four-consecutive-vertex obstructions paired with separator splicing yield a natural complete classification for all n,q; this is mathematically motivated by a basic graph-colouring class and its binary observable, not an arbitrary numerical refinement.
